Unit tests for ping tracking, pong registration, state transitions, and request timing.

# Purpose
This file is a C unit test program for `fd_ping_tracker`. It creates random peers, tracks them, pops ping requests, and checks pong registration with SHA-256 tokens. The tests verify that high-stake peers and entrypoints are not tracked, that low-stake peers are tracked, and that state change callbacks are called only for valid transitions. It also checks address changes, invalid state transitions, and random operation sequences to confirm tracker behavior over time.
